Name: Cave of Chaos
Author: iamsaulc
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/tUOnifV.png[/img]
[b]Cave of Chaos[/b] is a mod that adds a new cave filled with dangers and unique challenges. Once you repair the minecart, you will be able to access this mysterious cave, where different types of monsters spawn each day of the week:[quote]Monday: Bats and Green Slimes.
Tuesday: Blue Slimes, Skeletons, and Ghosts.
Wednesday: Magma enemies like Magma Sprite, Magma Duggy, and Red Slimes.
Thursday: Serpents, Mummies, Purple Slimes, and Iridium Bats.
Friday: All types of Slimes, including the Tiger Slime.
Saturday: Special encounter with Pepper Rex.
Sunday: Ghosts, Serpents, Royal Serpent, and Pepper Rex.[/quote]Monsters start spawning at 6:00 AM. It's the perfect place to farm rare materials, practice combat, and face ever-changing challenges.

[b]Future plans:

[/b][b]*-[/b] Add custom monsters. [b]Partially implemented[/b]
*- Introduce a new NPC with their own story.
*- Add a special shop inside the cave. ✅
*- Create new caves that also change depending on the day. [b]Partially implemented[/b]
*- And much more surprise content.

[i]If you have suggestions or ideas, feel free to share them in the forum I will create for that purpose.[/i][i]Please, if you find any bugs, report them by attaching your SMAPI log at https://smapi.io/log[/i][/center]
